`customer-enrichment.json` is the synthetic HTTP/PostgreSQL → S3 recipe,
copied from Braidplane/examples `recipes/http-customer-enrichment/http-customer-enrichment.pipeline.json`
(blob `b1ec777eb239cd7780e7d57230f37bc1a715cfdd`, Apache-2.0), on 2026-10-19.
It tests selected-version requirements without executing operations. The recipe's
validation and execution receipts do not establish binding-setup acceptance.
